skills.name: sl-overall-review
skills.description: Interactively pick a base branch, pick a review profile (universal/bug-fix/feature/refactor/research/performance/security/migration/algorithm/messaging/skill/docs), and run the matching reviewers in parallel against the diff. The `skill` profile reviews prompt artifacts themselves (SKILL.md and its bundle, subagents, slash commands, CLAUDE.md) against context-engineering principles for Claude 5 generation models. Outputs the findings as per-finding blocks.

skills.name: sl-gitlab-review-comments
skills.description: Add /sl-overall-review findings to a GitLab merge request as pending draft review notes (you submit them yourself in GitLab), inline on the diff, phrased in a suggestive register, with preview/confirm, per-run selection of findings (by number and/or severity), idempotent re-runs, and general-note fallback for lines outside the diff.

skills.name: sl-deepen-architecture
skills.description: Study the resting codebase and propose up to 3–4 high-leverage architecture improvements grounded in deep-module design (locality & leverage); rank by strength and deliver them either as a self-contained HTML proposal report (Files / Problem / Solution / Benefits / Before-After SVG / strength badge) saved to .skillsland/deepen-architecture/, or as plain text with ASCII diagrams in the chat. Read-only on code — proposes, does not implement.

skills.name: sl-arxiv-digest
skills.description: Multi-paper digest of recent arXiv papers (optional topics, default categories cs.AI + cs.LG, window default the last day), ranked by Semantic Scholar citation count with a disclosed newest-first fallback; each top paper explained in 2–4 plain-language sentences in the user's language, original English titles kept. Chat-only output.

skills.name: sl-hol-guard
skills.description: Set up and operate HOL Guard around local coding-agent runtimes so tool and command execution is mediated by Guard, with fail-closed setup, approval review, receipts, and optional plugin or skill package verification.
